intl_finance.document: Certification of Finances form, plus a bank statement or bank letter showing proof of funding and a copy of the passport information page. WPI asks for this from international applicants who are not applying for financial aid, only once they are accepted and will enroll; International House then emails instructions to submit financial documents and a passport copy, and issues the I-20 after receipt. Applicants applying for aid submit only the CSS Profile at application.

deadlines.label: Certification of Finances and financial documents for the I-20
deadlines.note: No date found. WPI says the form is required only for students who are accepted and will enroll.

intl_finance.notes: The latest copy of the form found (source 3) is the 2025-2026 version with a $86,746 estimated first-year total; the 2026-27 form was not seen. Source 4 (WPI FAQ) gives the I-20 step.

notes: wpi.edu blocks automated fetches, so Internet Archive copies of the official pages were read. WPI's how-to page (source 1) lists the Common App, fee, transcripts and two recommendations but says nothing about essays or supplements either way; the Common App 2026-27 requirements grid did not show a usable writing-supplement flag, so supplements are recorded as unknown, not none. Check WPI's Common App member page. Source 5 confirms international applicants seeking aid file the CSS Profile by the admissions deadline.
